summary: SIEM feed s081_single shows 2.7% TCP packet drops (41/1511 packets with gaps) exceeding 1% threshold; all other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror or packet broker ingress dropping under load: TCP sequence gaps across many flows indicate buffer/oversubscription drops before the SIEM, not tool-side overload (tool_overload healthy).
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM receives incomplete TCP streams - 2.7% missing data breaks event reconstruction and correlation, causing missed or incomplete alerts even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional flows.

recommended_fix.why: Hardware TAP provides lossless line-rate copy unlike SPAN which drops when oversubscribed; replacing SPAN with TAP (and ensuring broker capacity) eliminates the sequence gaps and restores complete traffic to the SIEM.
